advanced_hint: Persona picks the engine and the channel for you. Choose them here only to run on a specific route.
restore_none: This chat has no working setup to go back to yet
restored: Back on the last working setup
restore_failed: Couldn't restore the last working setup: {error}
runtimes_footer: The engines your computers can run, what each one speaks and which computers have it. An engine comes with a computer's install.
runtimes_empty: No engine is known yet. Connect a computer to see its engines.
channels_footer: A channel is how a model is reached: a gateway or an API with its key. Saving, deleting or rolling back never stops a running session; new sessions and each session's next turn use the change.
channels_empty: No managed channel yet. Add one to share a gateway between engines.
channels_live_note: Saving doesn't stop any running session: new sessions and each session's next turn use the change.
secret_kept: Saved. Leave empty to keep it
history_footer: The last ten changes to channels. Going back to one is a change too, so it can be undone the same way.
rolled_back: Channels went back to that point
point_rollback: Went back to an earlier point
conflict: Channels changed elsewhere in the meantime. The latest version has been loaded; make your change again.
err_name: Use letters, digits, _ or - for the name.
err_bindings: Each engine needs a launcher name.
alias_readonly_title: Its key, Base URL and computers come from channel {channel}
alias_readonly_detail: This provider belongs to channel {channel}. Change its key, Base URL or computers on the channel.
